Name: Better Signs - Lock Signs to Prevent Accidental Changes
Author: stebaker92
Description:
[size=5][b]Better Signs - Lock Your Signs to Prevent Accidental Changes[/b][/size]

Stop accidentally erasing your carefully organized farm signs! Better Signs prevents you from accidentally changing sign text or displayed items when you click on them.

[heading]The Problem This Solves[/heading]
Have you ever:
[list]
[*][b]Accidentally cleared[/b] a chest label you spent time writing?[/*]
[*][b]Lost track[/b] of what crops are planted in each area because you clicked a sign by mistake?[/*]
[*][b]Overwritten[/b] your greenhouse organization system?[/*]
[*][b]Wasted time[/b] rewriting the same signs over and over?[/*]
[/list]If you use signs for farm organization, you've definitely experienced this frustration.

[heading]✨ How Better Signs Works[/heading]
[b]Signs are now LOCKED by default[/b] once you place them down. No more accidental changes
[list]
[*]Place a sign and set the text/item[/*]
[*]The sign is automatically locked[/*]
[*]Click it all you want - nothing changes[/*]
[*]To edit: simply break and replace the sign[/*]
[/list][b]It's that simple. [/b]No more accidentally overwriting signs!


[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Prevents accidentally overwriting existing Signs that display an item or text[/*]
[*]Right clicking on a sign will no longer replace the display item or prompt to change the text[/*]
[*]To change a sign, destroy and place it back down[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.5 & 1.6 Compatible[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.1.10+[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Fully supported[/*]
[*][b]Other Mods:[/b] No known conflicts[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Frequently Asked Questions[/heading]
[b][i]Q: How do I edit a sign after placing it?[/i][/b]
A: Break the sign and place it again. This prevents accidental changes while allowing intentional edits.

[b][i]Q: Does this work with modded signs?[/i][/b]
A: Yes! Works with vanilla signs and most modded sign variations.

[b][i]Q: Will this affect my existing signs?[/i][/b]
A: No! Signs you've already placed will gain protection immediately.

[b][i]Q: Can I configure which signs are locked?[/i][/b]
A: Currently all signs are locked by default. This ensures consistent behavior.

[b][i]Q: Does this work in multiplayer?[/i][/b]
A: Yes! Each player with the mod installed will have sign protection.
